For explicit rational Y={y in R^D:Ay<=b}, q(y)=y^T H y/2+g^T y with H=H^T>=0, nonempty Y and q bounded below, let P select d observed coordinates and F(x)=min_{y in Y,Py=x}q(y), with +infinity outside feasible fibers. Time/output size are claimed polynomial in explicit input bits and epsilon^-1 using an imported rational convex-QP algorithm, without active-regime enumeration, unique minimizer or supplied spectral gap. This is a source-reported theorem, not independently established correctness or a general physical simulator.

The source explicitly credits the BEN/Fenchel variational action and prior dissipation-based error analysis. A_F(v)=integral[F(v)+F*(-v')]+(||v(T)||^2-||x0||^2)/2 controls squared state error by 2A. Feasible latent endpoint lifts and dual variables satisfying Hw_i+g+A^T lambda_i=P^T(x_{i-1}-x_i)/h_i, lambda_i>=0, bound this action by an explicit rational convex quadratic objective J. Feasibility and objective value, not trust in optimality, provide the proposed verifier interface. For N intervals the stated program has N(2D+m) variables, ND equalities and 2Nm inequalities; the initial lift, latent dimension and all inequalities are charged input.

With initial lift energy upper bound E0>0 and a=R^2/(2E0), h_i=min{eta(a+t_{i-1}),T-t_{i-1}}, the proximal witness and energy-distance inequality give J<=eta R^2/2. The reported N=ceil(log(1+2TE0/R^2)/log(1+eta)) is logarithmic in numerical T and O(epsilon^-2) at the chosen relative state accuracy. This does not give logarithmic precision cost: absolute error a_abs charges R/a_abs. Mesh rational numerators/denominators, QP bit sizes and optimizer operations all count.

Rational KKT witnesses identify the latent minimizer polyhedron without expanding its observed projection. An explicit loose Hoffman constant K=D0(DU)^(D-1) and C^2=K^2(2 sum_ij |H_ij|+E0) yield dist(x,argmin F)^2<=C^2(F(x)-m_*) on the energy sublevel. The source chooses T_*=8C^2/epsilon^2, computes a finite-horizon path, projects its terminal point to the minimizer set, changes only the last endpoint and appends a constant tail. C and physical T_* can be enormous; only their polynomial bit lengths and log(T_*) are charged. The proposed direct returned-certificate bound is sqrt(2J)+||v_N-s||. Independent review of attainment, degenerate/zero-energy cases, the explicit constant and all bit bounds remains open.

The nonsmooth example F(x,y)=x^2/2+max(0,x-y), x0=(1,0), has source-derived limit (0,alpha), where 2exp(-alpha)=1+alpha and alpha approximately 0.374822528183623, although metric projection to the minimizer set is (0,0). Fixed-count huge implicit steps also select the wrong limit. The response reports a 535-interval rational certificate with terminal time approximately 21.09755, s=(0,805659543/2147483648), J approximately 9.5720456943e-6 and exact comparison 2J<=1/40000, implying a 0.005 all-future bound for that example. The reloadable certificate, compiler, verifier, objective-comparison receipt and source ledger have been recovered in the original ZIP. Intake preserves them without replay or independent proof reconstruction. The source explicitly distinguishes its reported exact/specialized implementation from the unimplemented general polynomial-time QP optimizer.

For a supplied linear observable c, the proposed all-time safety-margin interface is |sup_{t>=0} c^T u(t)-max_i c^T v_i|<=epsilon R||c||. Acquiring a physically faithful convex energy, validated spatial discretization, measured parameters and any future input remains separate. No physical implementation, measured advantage or technology readiness follows from this supplied-model theorem.

Failures delimit the transfer: joint latent-variable descent changes the observed flow; a hidden forcing pulse costs Omega(N) interval queries in its specified access model; a constant tail loses persistent oscillatory phase; small nonconvex energy perturbations can change branches. The source credits classical foundations and leaves the complete theorem's historical priority and independent validation unresolved. Broader controlled, oscillatory and nonconvex capability is not established. Intermediate diffusion/metastability remarks remain transcript history, not separately promoted results. No status transfer or proof dependency on the distinct N701 Lindblad/coherent-oracle result is asserted.
